purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0095 in the quantum arena: the $Z_3$ toric code on the {3,4,3,4} mesh complex, with the tone alphabet as the qutrit: oriented vertex and triangle checks over the field of three elements commute exactly, and the number of logical qutrits by rank over $Z_3$ is four per four-torus (four at side 3, eight at the split even side 4) and zero on an open patch.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
